messages.message: ### Step 2: Direct Translation Translate each source line into Malayalam, guided by the Reference Translation and Step 1 analysis. Output: ONE Malayalam line per source line (preserve line count and end punctuation). Rules: - Follow the meaning from Reference Translation. - For "so X that Y": keep resultative structure, do NOT convert to "because". - No internal punctuation; copy only end punctuation from source.

### Step 3: Word Table & Coverage Check Build a word table from Step 2 translation, mapping each source word to its target equivalent. Output: ONE Markdown table (all lines combined). Columns: [Source Word] | [Contextual Definition] | [Target Word/Phrase] | [Back-Translation] | [Status: OK/MISSING/WRONG/GRAMMAR/UNNECESSARY] Mark GRAMMAR for agreement errors (gender, number, case) or other grammatical mistakes. Mark UNNECESSARY for elements present in source but not needed in target language (e.g., articles that target language omits naturally). After the table, list any MISSING, WRONG, GRAMMAR, or UNNECESSARY items.

**Word‑to‑Word Alignment Table (Step 3)**
| Source Word | Contextual Definition (from Step 1) | Target Word / Phrase (Malayalam) | Back‑Translation | Status | |-------------|--------------------------------------|----------------------------------|------------------|--------| | Ed | conjunction “And” | – | – | **UNNECESSARY** (Malayalam can omit the coordinating “and” here) | | ecco | interjection “lo!” (exclamatory pointer) | **ഇവിടെ** | “here” (used to draw attention) | **OK** | | quasi | adverb “almost” | **അടുത്തു** | “near / almost” | **OK** | | al | preposition + article “at the” | – | – | **UNNECESSARY** (locative sense is encoded in the case ending of “കയറ്റത്തിന്റെ”) | | cominciar | noun “beginning” | **ആരംഭം** | “beginning” | **OK** | | de | preposition “of” | **കയറ്റത്തിന്റെ** (genitive suffix “‑ത്തിന്റെ”) | “of the steep” | **OK** | | l'erta | noun “the steep” | **കയറ്റം** (root of “കയറ്റത്തിന്റെ”) | “steep (path)” | **OK** | | una | indefinite article “a” | **ഒരു** | “a / one” | **OK** | | lonza | noun “she‑leopard” | **ചിതലു** | “leopard” | **OK** | | leggera | adjective “light” | **ലഘുവായ** | “light” | **OK** | | e | coordinating conjunction “and” | – | – | **UNNECESSARY** (the two adjectives are simply juxtaposed) | | presta | adjective “nimble” | **ചപലമായ** | “nimble” | **OK** | | molto | adverb “very” | **വളരെ** | “very” | **OK** | | che | relative pronoun “which” | **അത്** | “which / that” | **OK** | | di | preposition “with” (instrumental) | **മുടിയാൽ** (instrumental suffix “‑യാൽ”) | “by the fur / with the fur” | **OK** | | pel | noun “coat / fur” | **മുടി** | “fur / coat” | **OK** | | macolato | adjective “spotted” | **ചുവട്ടുള്ള** | “spotted” | **OK** | | era | verb “was” (copula) | **മൂടപ്പെട്ടിരുന്നു** (part of the passive construction) | “was (covered)” | **OK** | | coverta | past participle “covered” (passive) | **മൂടപ്പെട്ടിരുന്നു** | “was covered” | **OK** |
---
### Items flagged after the table
- **UNNECESSARY**: `Ed`, `al`, `e` – these function words are not required in the Malayalam rendering and were omitted. - **MISSING**: none (all source meanings are represented, either directly or via morphological encoding). - **WRONG**: none. - **GRAMMAR**: none (no agreement or case errors detected in the Malayalam output).

### Step 4: Correction & Final Output Fix any MISSING, WRONG, or GRAMMAR items from Step 3. Reorder within line if needed; do not add new content words. Verify that the output contains only Malayalam script; no other language scripts should be mixed in. Output format (use nested bullet list, not table): - Line N: - Original: ... - Issue: ... (or "none") - Corrected: ... (or "no change") Output final Malayalam text in ONE code block, line by line (no extra prose).

- Line 31: - Original: ഇവിടെ കയറ്റത്തിന്റെ ആരംഭം അടുത്തു, - Issue: UNNECESSARY (“ഇവിടെ” is not required) - Corrected: കയറ്റത്തിന്റെ ആരംഭം അടുത്തു,
- Line 32: - Original: ഒരു ലഘുവായ വളരെ ചപലമായ ചിതലു, - Issue: none - Corrected: no change
- Line 33: - Original: അത് മുറുകിയ ചുവട്ടുള്ള മുടിയാൽ മൂടപ്പെട്ടിരുന്നു; - Issue: WRONG (added “മുറുകിയ” which is not in the source) - Corrected: അത് ചുവട്ടുള്ള മുടിയാൽ മൂടപ്പെട്ടിരുന്നു;
```malayalam കയറ്റത്തിന്റെ ആരംഭം അടുത്തു, ഒരു ലഘുവായ വളരെ ചപലമായ ചിതലു, അത് ചുവട്ടുള്ള മുടിയാൽ മൂടപ്പെട്ടിരുന്നു; ```
